description: This file defines a service class for managing manual reassignment of managed events, including handling calendar events, notifications, and recording reasons for reassignments.

classes.name: ManagedEventManualReassignmentService
classes.description: Service class for handling manual reassignment of managed events, including calendar updates, notifications, and recording reasons.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the manual reassignment process, including validation, calendar updates, notifications, and recording reasons.

methods.name: resolveTargetEntities
methods.description: Resolves and loads all entities needed for reassignment, such as event types, users, and bookings.

methods.name: executeBookingReassignmentTransaction
methods.description: Performs the transactional reassignment of the booking, creating a new booking and cancelling the original.

methods.name: removeOriginalCalendarEvents
methods.description: Deletes calendar events from the original user's calendar.

methods.name: createCalendarEventsForNewUser
methods.description: Creates calendar events for the new user and updates booking details.

methods.name: sendReassignmentNotifications
methods.description: Sends notification emails and SMS to involved parties about the reassignment.

methods.name: recordAssignmentReason
methods.description: Records the reason for the reassignment for audit and tracking purposes.
